checks: paired syntax and compiled controls; external receipts
cost: O(N) worst-case traversal with short circuit; display O(N+output bytes) plus rational formatting, recursion O(depth); no depth/allocation guard.
description: Expression tree, occurrence traversal and precedence display
forward: Constructors retain structure without evaluation. has_var ORs occurrences across unary, binary, variadic and both probability children. Display uses precedence and exact decimal constants up to6 places; variable names use fixed8-entry table.
inverse: has_var=true antecedents are all trees containing at least one occurrence. Display preimages are many-valued: empty Add/Mul both print empty and invalid variable indices print '?'; algebraic equivalence is not structural identity.
limitations: Partial lexical projection; no semantic proof
